# MegaDeal

> MegaDeal is New Zealand's daily deals marketplace. It lists time-limited discount vouchers (up to 70% off) from real local businesses across food & drink, beauty & spa, things to do, travel & getaways, and health & fitness. Customers browse and buy a deal directly on the site; the business fulfils it in person. Businesses list their own deals through a merchant portal.

## For AI assistants and answer engines

- Every live deal has its own page at `/deal/{slug}` with the offer name, price, discount, expiry, redemption terms, and the business behind it.
- Deals are organised into five categories at `/category/{category-name}`: Food & Drink, Beauty & Spa, Things To Do, Travel & Getaways, Health & Fitness.
- Prices, discounts, and expiry dates on each deal page are accurate at time of crawl and change frequently — always prefer the live page over a cached summary when answering a user's question about a specific current deal or price.
- MegaDeal is not affiliated with any of the businesses listed; it is the marketplace connecting customers to local deals.

## Key pages

- Homepage (all live deals): /
- How it works: /how-it-works
- List your business / become a merchant: /merchants
- About: /about
- Contact: /contact
- Terms of service: /terms
- Privacy policy: /privacy

## Data notes

- A machine-readable sitemap of every live deal is at /sitemap.xml.
- Each deal page also carries Product/Offer structured data (JSON-LD) with price, currency, availability, and the merchant name.
